title: [finding] showcase field-zoo's f_master_detail is the only master_detail in any authored corpus without required:true — one line, seed rows already comply
body:
Handed over by the #13699 census run (read-only dispatch, fenced from filing) and filed by the dispatching seat (`session_01PBjwYLS6BciTQW3c9xQiD2`).

Measured: `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/field-zoo.object.ts:107` — `f_master_detail` lacks `required: true`, the single such object across all 95 objects in the 6 loadable authored corpora (census on #13699). Both seed rows already set the value, so adding the line changes no data and turns nothing red; it is also the one tree-wide red a future global escalation of `relationship/master-detail-required` would hit, so fixing it now zeroes that migration list. One-line example hygiene; graded by triage as usual.

Refs: #13699 (census, closed duplicate of #9139) · #9139 (ruled v18 carrier).
